verdict.rationale: monday.com documents AI agents you can message or @mention in updates and get replies from, and markets 'deep intelligence and actionable insights.' It also lets external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT reach workspace data via its MCP. Nothing shows a dedicated Q&A experience that returns instant answers grounded in workspace content with citations. missing for 10: explicit workspace-wide Q&A/search answering feature, source citations or links in answers, evidence of instant response, independent or hands-on corroboration.
